chunks.head: take leave of
chunks.note: take leave of sb/sth = 向某人/某地道别；固定搭配，非字面'拿走'。

literal.note_cn: 此处非'拿'义,take leave 为固定搭配
此处为名词'告别',非动词'离开'

chunks.ex_en: She took leave of her friends before moving abroad.
chunks.ex_cn: 她出国前向朋友们道别。

chunks.head: meet with
chunks.gloss: 遭遇、遇到(尤指经历某事或某种对待)
chunks.note: meet with sth = 经历/遭遇(困难、反对、事故等),比 meet 多一层'亲历'意味。
chunks.ex_en: The plan met with strong opposition.
chunks.ex_cn: 这个计划遭到强烈反对。

chunks.head: make a will
chunks.note: make a/one's will = 订立遗嘱。

literal.note_cn: 此处名词'遗嘱',非'将要/意愿'

chunks.ex_en: The old man made a will to divide his house among his children.
chunks.ex_cn: 老人立了遗嘱,把房子分给孩子们。

chunks.head: take possession of
chunks.note: take possession of sth = 正式占有/接管某物。
chunks.ex_en: They took possession of the new house last week.
chunks.ex_cn: 他们上周搬进并拥有了新房子。

chunks.head: make use of
chunks.note: make use of sth = 加以利用某物。
chunks.ex_en: You should make use of every chance to practice English.
chunks.ex_cn: 你应该利用每个机会练习英语。

chunks.head: refrain from
chunks.note: refrain from doing sth = 克制自己不去做某事。
chunks.ex_en: Please refrain from talking during the movie.

chunks.head: in the meantime
chunks.note: 承接前后两件事之间的一段时间。
chunks.ex_en: Dinner is almost ready; in the meantime, please set the table.
chunks.ex_cn: 晚饭快好了,这期间请摆好餐桌。

chunks.head: of late
chunks.note: of late = 近来(略正式,常与完成时连用)。

literal.note_cn: 此处非'晚',of late 固定为'近来'

chunks.ex_en: He has been very busy of late.

chunks.head: now and then
chunks.note: now and then = 时不时地、偶尔。

literal.note_cn: now and then 固定表示'偶尔'

chunks.ex_en: We still meet for coffee now and then.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们偶尔还会一起喝咖啡。

chunks.head: in order to
chunks.note: in order to do sth = 为了做某事,引出目的。

literal.note_cn: in order to 中不作'命令/顺序'解

chunks.ex_en: He got up early in order to catch the first bus.
chunks.ex_cn: 他早起是为了赶上头班车。

chunks.head: single out
chunks.note: single sb/sth out = 从一群中单独挑出。

literal.note_cn: 此处作动词'单独选出',非形容词'单一的'

chunks.ex_en: The teacher singled out three students for praise.
chunks.ex_cn: 老师单独表扬了三名学生。

chunks.head: set out
chunks.ex_en: We set out for the mountains at dawn.
chunks.ex_cn: 我们黎明时动身前往山里。

chunks.head: presence of mind
chunks.note: have the presence of mind to do sth = 危急时头脑清醒、镇定应对。

literal.note_cn: 此处指头脑'在位',即神志清醒

chunks.ex_en: She had the presence of mind to call for help at once.

chunks.head: settle one's affairs
chunks.gloss: 料理事务、安排好(个人)事情
chunks.note: settle one's affairs = 把(自己的)事务处理妥当。

literal.note_cn: 此处指'(个人)事务',常用复数

chunks.ex_en: Before the long trip, he settled his affairs at home.
chunks.ex_cn: 长途旅行前,他把家里的事都安排好了。

chunks.head: account for
chunks.note: account for sth = 对某事作出解释/交代。
chunks.ex_en: Can you account for the missing money?
chunks.ex_cn: 你能解释这笔钱去哪了吗?

chunks.head: look after
chunks.note: look after sb/sth = 照顾、看护。

literal.note_cn: 此处非'看一眼',look after 固定为'照料'

chunks.ex_en: She looks after her grandmother every weekend.

chunks.head: what's the matter
chunks.note: 询问对方出了什么问题或麻烦;本章出处为过去式 what was the matter。

literal.note_cn: 此处名词'麻烦事/问题',非'物质'

过时惯用语 e.g. come to pass / all on a sudden / by and by
一次性 nautical/法律硬词 e.g. take shipping / weigh (起锚) / procurator-fiscal / bill of sale / take cognisance of / procuration
